## WireDate type

A point in time.

**Signature:**

```typescript
type WireDate = {
  readonly date: string
}
```

## Remarks

The payload is ISO 8601 with exactly three fractional digits and an explicit offset (`Z` or `±HH:MM`<!-- -->), for example `2026-10-31T17:04:05.120Z`<!-- -->. Encoders emit `Z`<!-- -->.
